title: Gesture Replay Kit
user: Indie game and classroom-toy makers using a webcam as input who need to tune a gesture game from recorded landmark traces without retaining children's or players' video.
smallest_useful_product: NPM library and local viewer that records only timestamped pose/hand landmarks, replays them at chosen speed, compares gesture rules, and exports a scrubbed fixture.
success_measure: Teams can reproduce 90% of reported false-positive/false-negative gestures from a landmark fixture without asking for the original video.
constraints: Never retain video by default; landmark data may still be biometric and needs consent/deletion controls; no age estimation or face identification.
